_doc: Task 51: finding work in person. A business with an opening in a job done there (careers.json workplace = the lot's type) puts a 'Help wanted' card in its front window; the pawn can ask the staff there, and people they know mention openings in a chat. Either one is a lead: that job can be applied for in person for lead_days. Read by JobLeads and HelpWantedView.

hiring: {who} glances at the sign. "Yes, {job}. You interested?"
"We are," {who} says. "We need {job}. It's hard work."
not_hiring: {who} shakes their head. "Nothing going right now."
"Not at the moment," {who} says. "Try again in a week or two."
turned_down: {who} looks you over. "We need someone with more experience."
"I don't think you're ready for it yet," {who} says.
{who} hesitates. "Maybe once you've got more under your belt."
mention_own: "We need {job} at work," {who} says. "You'd get on fine."
